title: UniRGBA: Unifying RGB and Alpha in Pretrained Video Diffusion Models
title_zh: UniRGBA：在预训练视频扩散模型中统一RGB与Alpha

paragraphs.en: UniRGBA通过对预训练视频扩散模型的最小扩展，实现原生RGBA视频生成且不损害RGB质量。 Recent advances in video diffusion models have achieved remarkable photorealistic RGB synthesis, yet generating videos with a native alpha channel remains an open challenge. Existing approaches often rely on matting-style data and non-native RGBA designs, causing them to specialize in real-object scenes and to degrade severely on visual-effect content whose semi-transparency is spatially non-local and non-elliptical. We present UniRGBA, a unified framework whose key insight is that RGBA generation does not require a dedicated alpha encoder or complex latent-space restructuring---a minimal, targeted extension of the existing RGB pathway is sufficient. UniRGBA-VAE extends a causal video VAE to 4-channel RGBA via zero-initialized channel expansion, symmetric selective layer unfreezing (5% trainable), and a six-term progressive reconstruction loss anchored by a KL reference loss that prevents latent drift, followed by a two-stage schedule that introduces a lightweight GAN objective. We then apply standard DoRA to the pretrained DiT, reusing the unified 4-channel latent without any alpha-specific architectural changes. On a visual-effect RGBA benchmark, UniRGBA substantially outperforms Wan-Alpha on RGBA reconstruction while preserving RGB fidelity. For generation, UniRGBA outperforms Wan-Alpha on RGBA text-to-video tasks and matches or surpasses the original pretrained Wan2.1 backbone on RGB-only metrics, demonstrating that native alpha support can be integrated without compromising the underlying RGB prior or the model's architectural versatility.
paragraphs.zh: UniRGBA通过对预训练视频扩散模型的最小扩展，实现原生RGBA视频生成且不损害RGB质量。近年来视频扩散模型在照片级真实的RGB合成方面取得了显著进展，然而生成带有原生alpha通道的视频仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。 现有方法通常依赖抠图风格的数据和非原生RGBA设计，导致它们专注于真实物体场景，而在视觉特效内容上性能严重退化——这类内容的半透明性在空间上是非局部且非椭圆的。 我们提出UniRGBA，一个统一框架，其关键洞察是RGBA生成并不需要专门的alpha编码器或复杂的潜空间重构——只需对现有RGB通路进行最小化、有针对性的扩展即可。 UniRGBA-VAE通过零初始化的通道扩展、对称的选择性层解冻（仅5%可训练参数）以及以KL参考损失（防止潜变量漂移）为锚点的六项渐进式重建损失，将因果视频VAE扩展为4通道RGBA，随后通过两阶段调度引入一个轻量级的GAN目标。 然后，我们将标准DoRA应用于预训练的DiT，直接复用统一的4通道潜变量，无需任何针对alpha的架构改动。 在一个视觉特效RGBA基准上，UniRGBA在RGBA重建方面大幅超越Wan-Alpha，同时保持了RGB保真度。 在生成方面，UniRGBA在RGBA文本生成视频任务上超越Wan-Alpha，并且在纯RGB指标上达到或超越原始预训练Wan2.1骨干网络，这表明可以在不损害底层RGB先验或模型架构通用性的前提下集成原生alpha支持。
